title: LTEE BioBrick Burden — Anderson Disorder Analogy (B6)
paper: Measuring the burden of hundreds of BioBricks defines an evolutionary limit on constructability (2024) Nat Comms
description: Models plasmid burden as Anderson disorder potential. Each BioBrick introduces a metabolic cost (burden) that reduces host growth rate. The distribution of burdens across 301 standardized BioBricks follows statistics analogous to disorder potentials in condensed-matter localization theory.
method: Burden is measured as relative growth-rate reduction: burden_i = 1 - (growth_plasmid_i / growth_control). The distribution of burdens across N plasmids is fitted to (1) normal, (2) log-normal, and (3) exponential models using MLE + AIC/BIC model selection. The Anderson analogy maps burden → disorder W, growth_rate → wavefunction amplitude, and plasmid interactions → hopping integrals.

burden_distribution.note: Synthetic parameters approximating the empirical distribution shape from the paper. Real data shows right-skewed burden distribution with most plasmids having small burden and a heavy tail.

anderson_mapping.note: Maps burden magnitude to disorder strength W in 1D Anderson model. Localization length xi = 105/(W^2) at band center for 1D.
